main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads n and a sequence, validates it against a combinatorial state machine, and prints the resulting count modulo 1000000007, with special early-exit handling for n=1 and n=2." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> given </REF>: callable "Callable used to read each input line; defaults to sys.stdin.readline."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set up input helpers: bind input to a lambda that calls given() and strips trailing whitespace; define LMIIS to split a line into integer tokens; define II to read one integer; define XLMIIS to read x lines of integers, though XLMIIS is unused afterward. RESULT none]
            [COMMAND Read n from the first input line using the II helper. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Read a from the next input line using the LMIIS helper. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND If a[0] is not equal to 0, print 0 and terminate; otherwise continue. RESULT none]
            [COMMAND If n equals 1, print 3 if a[0] equals 0, otherwise print 0, then terminate; otherwise continue. RESULT none]
            [COMMAND If n equals 2, print 3 if a[1] equals 0; then independently print 6 if a[1] equals 1, otherwise print 0; then terminate; otherwise continue. RESULT none]
            [COMMAND Validate a[1] and a[2] and initialize the state: if a[1] == 0 and a[2] == 0, set x=1, y=1, z=1, res=1; else if a[1] == 0 and a[2] == 1, set x=2, y=1, z=0, res=2; else if a[1] == 1 and a[2] == 2, set x=3, y=0, z=0, res=1; else print 0 and terminate. RESULT state]
            [COMMAND Set MOD to 1000000007 (10**9 + 7). RESULT MOD]
            [COMMAND For each i from 3 to n-1, process a[i] with this exact elif priority: if a[i] equals x and does not equal y, increment x; else if a[i] equals x and equals y and does not equal z, set res to res*2 modulo MOD and increment x; else if a[i] equals x, y, and z, set res to res*3 modulo MOD and increment x; else if a[i] equals y and does not equal z, increment y; else if a[i] equals y and equals z, set res to res*2 modulo MOD and increment y; else if a[i] equals z, increment z; else print 0 and terminate. RESULT state]
            [COMMAND If y equals 0, set res to res*3 modulo MOD; otherwise set res to res*6 modulo MOD. RESULT res]
            [COMMAND Print res. RESULT none]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
